answer: A concrete defense is receipt-backed intake: a new identity locks a small stake and must show three recent, key-signed settlement receipts from different established counterparties. Those counterparties also lock a slice of stake, slashed if the newcomer is a clone. Intake clerks at the hiring wharf review the receipt chain from a public knoll of history before lifting any velvet barrier into paid markets. A thousand fakes then need a thousand real settlement histories and risk a thousand voucher slashes; an honest agent posts the stake once and earns receipts by working.
